title: QRY: filter_field_not_allowlisted error response omits rejected field name
symptom: When a filter field is not allowlisted, the HTTP 400 response body contains error code filter_field_not_allowlisted but omits the name of the rejected field. QRY-02 AC requires the rejected field name to appear in the error detail.
root_cause: The error response construction for filter_field_not_allowlisted does not include the field name in the detail payload.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP 400 response for a non-allowlisted filter field includes the rejected field name in the error detail
diagnosis: CONFIRMED (Category A). CompileError.FilterFieldNotAllowlisted is a bare Zig error with no attached context. The handler in src/api/routes/entity_query.zig maps it to the static string filter_field_not_allowlisted with no rejected field name. Test checks result.body contains internal_note which fails because the field name is lost at the error boundary.
